description: Addresses at a CEP (Brazilian postal code) with coordinates (CNEFE/IBGE) and the companies registered there. Returns up to 20 addresses and up to 20 companies; the total number of addresses is in `pontos_total`. 10 free lookups per day per network; after that, the tool answers `free_limit` with `resets_at`.
name: consulta_cep
title: Check a CEP
